Against source «teeters», «historical receipts» and «hand-wringing», these restore instability, historical evidence and exaggerated lament. The receipt slang and original bodily gesture are lost; immediate comprehension and idiomatic mockery are gained.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d5572829f87714878b51","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«En los años 80 se tachó a las calculadoras de» repairs the translated sentence structure identified previously. I agree with the earlier counterargument that «y todo ello evitando el tráfico» is ordinary Spanish: shortening it is optional, and source «all while avoiding traffic» supplies its emphasis.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"1435bb2e0747e30736dc","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«A cada generación le toca su monstruo tecnológico: aparece un aparato nuevo» recasts and combines the opening; «Los pánicos se repiten con tanta puntualidad» makes the watch joke work explicitly. «Mirar un reloj de agujas» replaces the awkward abstraction. This preserves the source’s recurring panic and technological dependence jokes, trading compressed English phrasing for conversational Spanish. Keeping the historical arc is defensible; the earlier clause-for-clause objection no longer describes the introduction.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d5aaf12f0080c249d21c","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The candidate now includes «date: 2025-05-31», matching the source and repairing the established hard failure. «sourceHash: \"d5356a63e570\"» remains, but the packet does not establish its hashing convention; the earlier inference of a broken staleness check is unsupported. «../mobile-social.webp» retains the asset identity at the supplied translation path.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"fd937904d69ce522a613","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Cuándo la IA amplifica el aprendizaje y cuándo cortocircuita el desarrollo» explicitly restores both objects in source «amplifies learning versus short-circuits development». The previous pronoun ambiguity and claim about stopping learning are gone, resolving the substance regardless of the earlier severity disagreement.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"993d7b80927c3a031151","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The cited obstacles are repaired as «se tambalea», «repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras». These convey coherent images without requiring readers to reconstruct English expressions. Current overall readability reaches 4/5; «un mundo aumentado por la IA» remains somewhat stiff but understandable.","evidenceIds":["target"]},{"issueId":"fe3c8c8479e5dce0085a","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"Source «teeters», «historical receipts» and «hand-wringing» now correspond to «se tambalea», «el historial de estos pánicos» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras». The earlier meaning errors are absent. The historical-evidence image becomes less slangy, while the lament becomes more theatrical; both adaptations preserve the argumentative purpose.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"ad7da4881b280c0caa0b","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Enseñar a usarla bien» restores directness, and «fomentar la alfabetización en IA» replaces the awkward gerund construction. The opening now says «se tambalea». The remaining educational register is supported by source «building literacy around it», as earlier opposing votes correctly observed; it does not independently constitute voice damage.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"37ef2170dd8bb0f0f5fe","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» communicates the historical-evidence function of «check our historical receipts» without relying on the English slang sense of receipts. It sacrifices that particular slang flourish but gains a clear invitation to inspect precedent. The earlier idiomatic-credibility problem is fixed.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"4f77ea87f90afbdf804b","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"Current frontmatter contains «date: 2025-05-31» before «modified: 2025-06-02», matching the source. This directly repairs the publication-date omission on which the previous blocking decision rested; no inference about build behavior is needed.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"e54c07c2cfa3892756cf","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«La civilización se tambalea», «repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras» remove all three previously identified interruptions. The earlier assessment concerned wording that is no longer present. Current readability is 4/5, with intelligible argument, idiomatic humor and a brisk ending.","evidenceIds":["target"]},{"issueId":"f1345c8c0b1352cda0fb","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Nota de agradecimiento a mano» retains the successful adaptation; «monstruo tecnológico» now conveys source «bogeyman». «Historial de estos pánicos» and «se rasga hoy las vestiduras» repair the unsuccessful images. The adaptation loses the receipt slang but restores the evidence-checking function and gives the lament a recognizable Spanish expression.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d5a97124474a233893a4","verdict":"reject","severity":2,"reason":"«Hay niños de 12 años» foregrounds the assertion, but source «12-year-olds who couldn't write … yet can “write”» already presents the same contrast without marking it hypothetical. «No sabrían», the quotation marks around «escribir», and surrounding «pánico»/«hiperventilar» retain the rhetorical framing. Reintegration could improve nuance, but this is not an established new factual claim.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"5b32eec3df59a17eb2c5","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"«Cortocircuita el desarrollo» conveys source «short-circuits development» through a comprehensible electrical metaphor, particularly for software developers. «Desarrollo» is equally abstract in the source. Adding «de sus capacidades» supplies an interpretation rather than repairing a demonstrated defect; the current wording also preserves the distinction restored after the earlier faithfulness finding.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"9cc164db4260f1a9d5cd","verdict":"reject","severity":2,"reason":"«Recursos de clase mundial» is understandable and preserves the evaluative force of source «world-class resources». «Recursos de primer nivel» is a useful stylistic alternative, but the source itself supplies the elevated assessment. A preference for the shorter expression does not establish a translation error.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"8140bf7c760e6a8c99c1","verdict":"reject","severity":2,"reason":"«Considera el GPS», «mapas en papel», «cualquier ciudad» and «tráfico» disambiguate «navegar con más frecuencia». «Orientarnos» would sound more conversational, but the current expression preserves source «navigate more often» and does not create a material ambiguity in this paragraph.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"e302bdc6a769c958e02f","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"Source «will surely follow this pattern» expresses confident expectation; «seguirá seguramente este patrón» is a defensible equivalent, with the same footnote caveat attached. The packet does not support the claim about how most Spanish speakers read it. «Sin duda» would make certainty more categorical; the sound repetition alone is an optional polish concern.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"d26720575e4fd2a4c637","verdict":"reject","severity":2,"reason":"The separation in «Hay niños de 12 años que no sabrían … pero pueden “escribir”» gives the example more prominence, as the objection notes. However, source «before we hyperventilate about 12-year-olds who couldn't … yet can» already presupposes that example. The surrounding panic framing and conditional survive, making reintegration optional rather than a required factual repair.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"8c507113204d0e791f96","verdict":"reject","severity":2,"reason":"«Repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» loses the slang flavor of «check our historical receipts», but preserves the challenge to examine precedent. This is a defensible adaptation: less slang, greater immediate clarity, with dry mockery retained in «Antes de hiperventilar». Neither proposed alternative demonstrably restores more edge, so further revision is optional.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]}]}
